title: Vague autonomy claims do not prove decision rights

units.rationale: High-ownership branding does not specify who approves routine technical decisions.
required_points: The source offers only broad culture language.
forbidden_inferences: Do not translate entrepreneurial culture into formal decision authority.

units.rationale: Optional gatherings and no required attendance satisfy zero compulsory days.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim gatherings never occur.

units.rationale: Required core meetings end by 16:00, inside the candidate’s 17:00 soft ceiling.
required_points: Required core meetings end by 16:00 Europe/Zurich.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer that optional meetings never occur after core hours.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Vague autonomy claims do not prove decision rights: the autonomy preference or its cited role term.
Using a meeting-hours citation for the autonomy result leaves pref_autonomy without relevant cited evidence.

notes: Broad cultural adjectives are insufficient evidence for a precise authority requirement.
